statement: The client has a Cautious risk profile (risk class 2) with an investment horizon of 6 years, an objective of income generation, and a capacity to bear limited losses up to 10%. The proposed portfolio is suitable for this client. It consists of the Xtrackers II EUR Overnight Rate Swap UCITS ETF 1C (SRI 1) and Carmignac Sécurité AW EUR Acc (SRI 2), resulting in a weighted average SRI of 1.5. This aligns with the client's risk class 2, which has a maximum allowed average SRI of 2.5 and a maximum individual fund SRI of 3. Draft for advisor review and signature.
